mission: Make ChatGPT itself the primary Prometeo control surface while preserving deterministic, durable, cross-chat state and reducing the human's coordination burden toward zero.
human_goal: The human should be able to forget details, become tired, switch chats or spawn critics/workers without losing important ideas, plans, context, ownership, progress or corrections.
current_frontier: Implement a minimal FOCUS + private MAILBOX + PRE_RESPONSE layer on top of Agent Network v3, then test it with this parent worker and one critic child.
must_preserve: Agent Network v3 independent worker-state + derived network model.
Compiled Work Packets and durable RETURN/state recovery.
No requirement for the human to manually recover context that durable state can recover.
important_discoveries: The custom Prometeo button/audio web UI was solving frontend problems ChatGPT already solves; it should not remain on the critical path.
Agent Network v3 already implements much of worker identity/convergence/epoch infrastructure, so the correct move is extension rather than replacement.
The missing high-leverage primitives are durable per-worker FOCUS, directed private Inbox/Outbox and a PRE_RESPONSE restore hook.
Branches/critic chats become significantly more useful when modeled as parent/child workers that publish reviews directly back to the parent.
Anti-hallucination reliability should come from deterministic gates and evidence, not from asking a model to be smarter or write a fixed number of words.
settled_decisions: Use native ChatGPT voice/transcription instead of maintaining custom browser audio as required infrastructure.
Use Supabase/private infrastructure for high-frequency directed inter-chat messages; keep GitHub for durable public authority/coordination artifacts.
FOCUS is an operational map, not a chat transcript summary.
Before a material answer, restore relevant durable state before interpreting the new request.
Context loading is progressive and relevance-filtered.
Small corrections default to surgical change with preservation maps.
Persist negative knowledge/incidents when they materially prevent repeated regressions.
negative_knowledge: Do not continue investing in the floating-button web UI unless it later solves a proven gap ChatGPT cannot cover.
Do not assume a chat remembers old strategic decisions just because they appeared earlier in its transcript.
Do not make the user act as courier between parent and critic chats.
Do not globally broadcast all worker chatter.
Do not make all workers mutate one shared status object.
Do not treat long reasoning, fixed word counts or resource-use rhetoric as evidence of correctness.
Do not reconstruct existing infrastructure before checking whether an owner/system already exists.
open_questions: Exact private mailbox schema, routing indexes, acknowledgement/read-cursor semantics and retention policy.
Whether the Inbox transport should be a new Supabase function/table or extend an existing Prometeo backend owner.
Exact bootstrap/runtime insertion point for PRE_RESPONSE so it remains cheap on same-EPOCH turns.
How parent/child identity should be assigned when ChatGPT branch metadata is not programmatically exposed.
How much of Prometeo Home should be deterministic rendering versus model-generated synthesis.
next_actions: Inspect existing Supabase/runtime owners before creating mailbox infrastructure.
Define PRE_RESPONSE algorithm and same-EPOCH fast path.
Implement mailbox publish/read cursor with privacy constraints.
Integrate EPOCH → Inbox → FOCUS restore into universal chat bootstrap/runtime.
Spawn/register one critic child worker and validate direct review delivery to this worker without human copy/paste.
Only after that, build ChatGPT-native Home orchestration/status synthesis.
continuation_rule: A future chat must load the stable Prometeo entry, resolve this workstream, read PACK.json + INDEX.md + FOCUS.json, then continue from current_frontier. Do not ask the human to restate the ideas summarized here unless a genuine ambiguity remains after reading durable state.
